text.headline:
Machine Learning History
1999 - 2025
text.text: Machine learning from 1999 to 2025 shifted from basic statistical tools to deep learning booms and massive generative AI models.

media.caption: Introduction to Weka: Key Features and Applications - GeeksforGeeks

text.headline: Weka Development
text.text: Weka into a prominent Java-based open-source tool and the foundational work on neural language models occurred around this vital turn-of-the-millennium period.

text.headline: Torch
text.text: Authors Ronan Collobert, Samy Bengio, and Johnny Mariéthoz at the Idiap Research Institute officially released Torch, making it one of the earliest and most influential open-source machine learning frameworks.

media.caption: Geoffrey E Hinton, a pioneer in deep learning and neural networks, received the ACM A.M. Turing Award in 2018 for his groundbreaking contributions to the field of artificial intelligence.

text.headline: The Birth of Deep Learning
text.text: The turning point for artificial intelligence and data science when Geoffrey Hinton published foundational work on deep belief networks and Netflix launched its open $1 million machine learning competition.

media.caption: 2012 AlexNet and the Deep Learning Revolution

text.headline: 2010s: The Deep Learning Revolution
text.text: The 2012 ImageNet competition was the definitive turning point that launched the modern era of Artificial Intelligence. By achieving a top-5 error rate of 15.3% compared to the runner-up's 26.2%, AlexNet proved that deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) scaled by Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) were vastly superior to traditional, hand-crafted computer vision methods.

text.headline: AlphaGo vs. Lee Sedol
text.text: : AlphaGo beats Lee Sedol at Go; the Transformer architecture debuts in the landmark paper Attention Is All You Need, completely changing language tasks. These proved that machine learning and deep neural networks could master intuition and creative strategy in a deeply complex game once thought immune to brute-force calculation.

text.headline: The Transformer Debut
text.text: Introduced by eight Google Brain researchers in the landmark paper 'Attention Is All You Need'. These Became the foundational blueprint powering nearly all modern large language models, including ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.

media.caption: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding

text.headline: BERT
text.text: Google Research introduced BERT, a deep learning model that revolutionized natural language processing by using bidirectional training on transformer encoders. It set new performance records across 11 major language tasks..

media.caption: GPT-3: The Future of Generative AI

text.headline: Generative AI and Scaling
text.text: The release of GPT-3 by OpenAI in 2020 marked a turning point in artificial intelligence by proving that massive scale produces powerful, unexpected language skills. It changed how machines handle human text through sheer size and data.
